scripts.build: pnpm clean && microbundle -i ./src/index.mjs -o dist -f umd --no-sourcemap && microbundle -i ./src/index.mjs -o docs -f umd && node ./scripts/build-docs.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly && node ./scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm clean && concurrently "microbundle watch -i ./src/index.mjs -o docs -f umd" "node ./scripts/build-docs.mjs --watch" "serve docs"
